asset_set: Questionnaire Q20 option 1 — Mentoring first-generation students

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under textbook and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; subtle wood-grain suggestion on table via 3 parallel lines max
art_style.mood: warm patient mentorship energy — approachable support, not a formal lecture
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: lavender appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on textbook cover and charm surface
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under textbook and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: slides the open textbook across the table toward the mentee side
left_hand.grip: flat palm guiding the book's edge
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: offers a small graduation-cap charm as encouragement
right_hand.grip: pinched between thumb and index finger

pose.gesture_summary: mid-encouragement freeze frame — the charm offered as the book arrives
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands slides an open textbook across a library table toward an unseen mentee while the other offers a small graduation-cap charm as a gesture of encouragement. The scene reads as warm, patient mentorship — a quiet moment of support, not a formal lecture.

primary_objects.name: textbook
primary_objects.detail: open to a page with a simple lavender bookmark ribbon, no readable text

primary_objects.name: graduation-cap charm
primary_objects.detail: tiny mortarboard shape on a keyring loop

primary_objects.name: bookmark ribbon
primary_objects.detail: draped across the open textbook page

subject.environment: quiet library table strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no bookshelf wall

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from textbook → bookmark → charm hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
composition.thumbnail_readability: textbook silhouette + two hand shapes readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter S, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, distressed or crying student, empty sad classroom, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Mentoring first-generation students". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms in a soft steel-blue knit cardigan with lavender #9575CD cuff trim. Left hand slides an open steel-blue textbook with a lavender bookmark ribbon across a birch library table. Right hand pinches a small lavender graduation-cap charm, offering it forward as encouragement. A lavender lanyard loops once at the wrist. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, generous transparent margins, quiet library table strip fading to transparent. Mood: warm patient supportive mentorship, quiet encouragement not a formal lecture. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size.
